WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    pageviews,
    CASE WHEN transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END AS classification
  FROM sessions
),
visitor_month_class AS (
  SELECT
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) AS total_pageviews
  FROM classified
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
averages AS (
  SELECT
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', month) AS month,
    classification,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_pageviews), COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId)) AS avg_pageviews_per_visitor
  FROM visitor_month_class
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) AS avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews_per_visitor END) AS avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM averages
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Let me also verify using the HAVING COUNT(*) / 365.0 >= 0.90 approach to make sure
SELECT COUNT(*) as final_count
FROM (
  SELECT g.stn, g.wban, COUNT(*) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
    ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE s.begin <= '20000101' 
    AND s.`end` >= '20190630'
    AND g.temp != 9999.9 
    AND g.max != 9999.9 
    AND g.min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY g.stn, g.wban
  HAVING SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), 365.0) >= 0.90
)

-- Alternative: all stations in stations table with valid USAF as denominator
-- First, get stations from gsod2022 that meet the criteria
WITH station_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        stn,
        COUNT(*) AS total_days,
        SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                 AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                 AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_days
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
    WHERE stn != '999999'
    GROUP BY stn
),
qualifying_stations AS (
    SELECT stn FROM station_stats
    WHERE valid_days * 1.0 / total_days >= 0.9
),
all_stations AS (
    SELECT usaf AS stn FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations`
    WHERE usaf != '999999'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qualifying_stations),
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM all_stations)
    ) * 100, 2) AS percentage

WITH complaint_totals AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, COUNT(*) as total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
),
daily_complaints AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as d, complaint_type, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date), complaint_type
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT DATE(created_date) as d, COUNT(*) as total
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE DATE(created_date) BETWEEN '2011-01-01' AND '2020-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(created_date)
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT dc.d, dc.complaint_type, SAFE_DIVIDE(dc.cnt, dt.total) as proportion
  FROM daily_complaints dc
  JOIN daily_totals dt ON dc.d = dt.d
),
wind_speed AS (
  SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) as d, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) as wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT PARSE_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
  UNION ALL SELECT date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND wdsp != '999.9'
),
combined AS (
  SELECT dp.complaint_type, dp.proportion, ws.wind_speed
  FROM daily_proportions dp
  JOIN wind_speed ws ON dp.d = ws.d
  WHERE dp.complaint_type IN (SELECT complaint_type FROM complaint_totals)
),
stats AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, 
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(proportion * wind_speed) as sum_xy,
    SUM(proportion) as sum_x,
    SUM(wind_speed) as sum_y,
    SUM(proportion * proportion) as sum_x2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) as sum_y2
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY complaint_type
),
correlations AS (
  SELECT complaint_type, 
    SAFE_DIVIDE(n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y, 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))) as raw_r,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y, 
      SQRT((n * sum_x2 - POWER(sum_x, 2)) * (n * sum_y2 - POWER(sum_y, 2)))), 4) as pearson_r
  FROM stats
)
SELECT complaint_type, raw_r, pearson_r FROM correlations 
WHERE pearson_r IN ((SELECT MAX(pearson_r) FROM correlations), (SELECT MIN(pearson_r) FROM correlations))
ORDER BY pearson_r DESC

WITH nyc_zip_codes AS (
  SELECT zip_code, zip_code_geom
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes`
  WHERE state_code = 'NY' AND zip_code LIKE '10%'
),
trips_jan1 AS (
  SELECT 
    pickup_datetime,
    pickup_latitude,
    pickup_longitude,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM pickup_datetime) AS hour
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015`
  WHERE DATE(pickup_datetime) = '2015-01-01'
    AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
    AND pickup_latitude BETWEEN 40.5 AND 41.0
    AND pickup_longitude BETWEEN -74.3 AND -73.7
),
trips_with_zip AS (
  SELECT 
    t.pickup_datetime,
    t.hour,
    z.zip_code
  FROM trips_jan1 t
  CROSS JOIN nyc_zip_codes z
  WHERE ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
),
-- Count trips per (zip_code, hour) for Jan 1
jan1_counts AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM trips_with_zip
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
-- All zip codes
all_zips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code FROM nyc_zip_codes
),
all_hours AS (
  SELECT hour FROM UNNEST(GENERATE_ARRAY(0, 23)) AS hour
),
-- Cross join for complete grid
grid AS (
  SELECT z.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM all_zips z
  CROSS JOIN all_hours h
),
-- Full grid with Jan 1 counts
full_grid AS (
  SELECT 
    g.zip_code,
    g.hour,
    COALESCE(jc.total_trips, 0) as total_trips
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN jan1_counts jc
    ON g.zip_code = jc.zip_code
    AND g.hour = jc.hour
),
-- Get 1hr_ago counts by joining with shifted hours
jan1_counts_shifted AS (
  SELECT 
    zip_code,
    CASE WHEN hour = 23 THEN 0 ELSE hour + 1 END as shifted_hour,
    total_trips
  FROM jan1_counts
)
SELECT 
  fg.zip_code,
  fg.hour,
  fg.total_trips,
  COALESCE(sc.total_trips, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
  0 as trips_1day_ago,
  0 as trips_7days_ago,
  0 as trips_14days_ago,
  NULL as ma_14day,
  NULL as stddev_14day,
  NULL as ma_21day,
  NULL as stddev_21day
FROM full_grid fg
LEFT JOIN jan1_counts_shifted sc
  ON fg.zip_code = sc.zip_code
  AND fg.hour = sc.shifted_hour
ORDER BY fg.total_trips DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH chicago AS (
  SELECT 41.8319 AS lat, -87.6847 AS lon
),
stations_with_distance AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.name,
    s.latitude,
    s.longitude,
    -- Haversine distance in km using acos(-1) for pi
    6371.0 * ACOS(
      LEAST(
        COS(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * COS(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180) *
        COS(acos(-1) * s.longitude / 180 - acos(-1) * chicago.lon / 180) +
        SIN(acos(-1) * chicago.lat / 180) * SIN(acos(-1) * s.latitude / 180),
        1.0
      )
    ) AS distance_km
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_stations` s
  CROSS JOIN chicago
)
SELECT
  id,
  name,
  ROUND(distance_km, 2) AS distance_km
FROM stations_with_distance
WHERE distance_km <= 50
ORDER BY distance_km

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    new_confirmed,
    LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) AS prev_new_confirmed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0
    AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
)
SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) AS mm_dd,
  new_confirmed,
  prev_new_confirmed,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - prev_new_confirmed, prev_new_confirmed) AS growth_rate
FROM daily
WHERE prev_new_confirmed IS NOT NULL AND prev_new_confirmed > 0
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2019-12-31' THEN '2019'
      WHEN date >= '2020-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31' THEN '2020'
    END as year,
    AVG(SAFE_CAST(symptom_Anosmia AS FLOAT64)) as avg_anosmia
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_1 = 'New York' 
    AND sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
    AND (date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31')
    AND symptom_Anosmia IS NOT NULL AND symptom_Anosmia != ''
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_anosmia END) as avg_2019,
  MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_anosmia END) as avg_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE((MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2020' THEN avg_anosmia END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_anosmia END)), MAX(CASE WHEN year = '2019' THEN avg_anosmia END)) * 100 as pct_change
FROM yearly_avg

SELECT 
  za.zipcode,
  za.zipcode_geom AS polygon,
  za.area_land_meters,
  za.area_water_meters,
  za.latitude,
  za.longitude,
  za.state_code,
  za.state_name,
  za.city,
  za.county,
  COALESCE(male_pop.population, 0) + COALESCE(female_pop.population, 0) AS total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT zipcode, SUM(population) AS population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender = 'male'
  GROUP BY zipcode
) male_pop ON za.zipcode = male_pop.zipcode
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT zipcode, SUM(population) AS population
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010`
  WHERE gender = 'female'
  GROUP BY zipcode
) female_pop ON za.zipcode = female_pop.zipcode
WHERE ST_DWITHIN(
  ST_GEOGPOINT(za.longitude, za.latitude),
  ST_GEOGPOINT(-122.3321, 47.6062),
  10000
)

WITH tract_2011 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
),
tract_2018 AS (
  SELECT geo_id, total_pop, median_income
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr`
  WHERE geo_id LIKE '36047%'
),
joined AS (
  SELECT 
    a.geo_id,
    a.total_pop AS pop_2011,
    b.total_pop AS pop_2018,
    a.median_income AS income_2011,
    b.median_income AS income_2018,
    SAFE_DIVIDE((b.total_pop - a.total_pop), a.total_pop) * 100 AS pop_pct_increase,
    (b.median_income - a.median_income) AS income_abs_increase
  FROM tract_2011 a
  JOIN tract_2018 b ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
  WHERE a.total_pop > 1000 AND b.total_pop > 1000
),
ranked_pop AS (
  SELECT *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) AS pop_rank
  FROM joined
),
ranked_income AS (
  SELECT *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) AS income_rank
  FROM joined
)
SELECT 
  a.geo_id,
  a.pop_2011,
  a.pop_2018,
  ROUND(a.pop_pct_increase, 2) AS pop_pct_increase,
  a.income_2011,
  a.income_2018,
  a.income_abs_increase,
  a.pop_rank,
  b.income_rank
FROM ranked_pop a
JOIN ranked_income b ON a.geo_id = b.geo_id
WHERE a.pop_rank <= 20 AND b.income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY a.pop_pct_increase DESC

-- Final query with proper coordinate adjustment
-- The documentation formula normalizes coordinates:
-- X: if event_coord_x < 564, keep as is; else 1128 - event_coord_x
-- Y: if event_coord_x < 564, use 600 - event_coord_y; else keep event_coord_y
SELECT 
  shot_type,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x END), 2) as avg_x,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y ELSE event_coord_y END), 2) as avg_y,
  ROUND(AVG(1.0), 2) as avg_shot_attempts,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN shot_made = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2) as avg_successful_shots
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
WHERE shot_type IS NOT NULL AND shot_type != ''
  AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL 
  AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
  AND scheduled_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-03-15 00:00:00')
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY shot_type

WITH year2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q1`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q2`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q3`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_q4`
),
year2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q1`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q2`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q3`
  UNION ALL
  SELECT geoid, month3_emplvl_23_construction
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_q4`
),
avg2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emp_2000
  FROM year2000
  GROUP BY geoid
),
avg2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_emp_2018
  FROM year2018
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT uc.geo_id, uc.county_name, 
       a2000.avg_emp_2000, 
       a2018.avg_emp_2018,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(a2018.avg_emp_2018 - a2000.avg_emp_2000, a2000.avg_emp_2000) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties` uc
LEFT JOIN avg2000 a2000 ON uc.geo_id = a2000.geoid
LEFT JOIN avg2018 a2018 ON uc.geo_id = a2018.geoid
WHERE uc.state_fips_code = '49'
  AND a2000.avg_emp_2000 IS NOT NULL 
  AND a2000.avg_emp_2000 > 0
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_white, race_black, race_asian, race_hispanic_latinx
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) as avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) as avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) as avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) as avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021 
    AND (
      subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services')
      OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services'
    )
)
SELECT 
  race,
  ROUND(google_pct, 4) as google_pct,
  ROUND(bls_pct, 4) as bls_pct,
  ROUND(difference, 4) as difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    'White' as race,
    g.race_white as google_pct,
    b.avg_white as bls_pct,
    g.race_white - b.avg_white as difference
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black or African American' as race,
    g.race_black as google_pct,
    b.avg_black as bls_pct,
    g.race_black - b.avg_black as difference
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Asian' as race,
    g.race_asian as google_pct,
    b.avg_asian as bls_pct,
    g.race_asian - b.avg_asian as difference
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_avg b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latino' as race,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx as google_pct,
    b.avg_hispanic as bls_pct,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic as difference
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_avg b
)
ORDER BY ABS(difference) DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH monthly_thefts AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS theft_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_crime.crime`
  WHERE primary_type = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year, month
)
SELECT 
  year,
  MAX(theft_count) AS highest_monthly_thefts
FROM monthly_thefts
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH trade_data AS (
  SELECT
    TradeReportID AS tradeID,
    MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
    CASE
      WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
      WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
      WHEN LEFT(TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
    END AS algorithm,
    Symbol AS symbol,
    LastPx AS openPrice,
    StrikePrice AS closePrice,
    s.Side AS tradeDirection,
    CASE WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tradeMultiplier
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report`,
  UNNEST(Sides) AS s
)
SELECT *
FROM trade_data
ORDER BY closePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

WITH condition_acres AS (
  SELECT 
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    p.state_code,
    c.condition_status_code,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot, 1.0) * c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted) as subplot_acres,
    SUM(p.expansion_factor * COALESCE(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot, 0.0) * COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0.0)) as macroplot_acres
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    AND p.inventory_year = 2012
    AND c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, p.state_code, c.condition_status_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_type, evaluation_description, state_code, condition_status_code, macroplot_acres, subplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM condition_acres
)
SELECT evaluation_group, evaluation_type, condition_status_code, evaluation_description, CAST(state_code AS STRING) as state_code, macroplot_acres, subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH weekend_weather_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    atmospheric_conditions_1_name AS weather,
    COUNT(*) AS accident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.nhtsa_traffic_fatalities.accident_2016`
  WHERE year_of_crash = 2016
    AND day_of_week IN (1, 7)
    AND atmospheric_conditions_1_name IN ('Rain', 'Clear')
  GROUP BY state_name, atmospheric_conditions_1_name
),
state_weather_pivot AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN weather = 'Rain' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS rainy_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN weather = 'Clear' THEN accident_count ELSE 0 END) AS clear_count
  FROM weekend_weather_counts
  GROUP BY state_name
)
SELECT 
  state_name,
  rainy_count - clear_count AS difference
FROM state_weather_pivot
WHERE rainy_count > 0 OR clear_count > 0

WITH snap_agg AS (

acs_income AS (

),
fips_names AS (

)
SELECT

WITH births AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM Year) as year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Maternal_Morbidity_YN = 1 THEN Births ELSE 0 END) as no_morbidity_births,
    SUM(Births) as total_births
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.sdoh_cdc_wonder_natality.county_natality_by_maternal_morbidity`
  WHERE Year IN (DATE('2016-01-01'), DATE('2017-01-01'), DATE('2018-01-01'))
    AND Maternal_Morbidity_YN IN (0, 1)
    AND County_of_Residence_FIPS NOT LIKE '%999'
  GROUP BY Year, County_of_Residence_FIPS
),
birth_rates AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    County_of_Residence_FIPS,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(no_morbidity_births, total_births) as pct_no_morbidity
  FROM births
),
census_poverty AS (
  SELECT '2015' as census_year, geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2015_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2016' as census_year, geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2016_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2017' as census_year, geo_id, SAFE_DIVIDE(poverty, pop_determined_poverty_status) as poverty_rate
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2017_5yr`
  WHERE pop_determined_poverty_status > 0
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    br.year,
    br.pct_no_morbidity as y,
    cp.poverty_rate as x
  FROM birth_rates br
  INNER JOIN census_poverty cp 
    ON br.County_of_Residence_FIPS = cp.geo_id
    AND CAST(br.year - 1 AS STRING) = cp.census_year
  WHERE br.pct_no_morbidity IS NOT NULL 
    AND cp.poverty_rate IS NOT NULL
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    COUNT(*) as n,
    SUM(x) as sum_x,
    SUM(y) as sum_y,
    SUM(x * x) as sum_x2,
    SUM(y * y) as sum_y2,
    SUM(x * y) as sum_xy
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  n,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y,
    SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y))
  ) as pearson_correlation
FROM stats

WITH users_2021 AS (
  SELECT id, creation_date, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(creation_date), MONTH) as creation_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
total_per_month AS (
  SELECT creation_month, COUNT(*) as total_users
  FROM users_2021
  GROUP BY creation_month
),
users_first_q AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id as user_id,
    u.creation_month,
    MIN(q.creation_date) as first_question_date
  FROM users_2021 u
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q ON u.id = q.owner_user_id
  WHERE q.creation_date BETWEEN u.creation_date AND TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.creation_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.id, u.creation_month
),
asked_per_month AS (
  SELECT creation_month, COUNT(*) as asked_within_30
  FROM users_first_q
  GROUP BY creation_month
),
users_answered AS (
  SELECT 
    ufq.user_id,
    ufq.creation_month,
    MIN(a.creation_date) as first_answer_date
  FROM users_first_q ufq
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a ON ufq.user_id = a.owner_user_id
  WHERE a.creation_date > ufq.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(ufq.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY ufq.user_id, ufq.creation_month
),
answered_per_month AS (
  SELECT creation_month, COUNT(*) as answered_within_30
  FROM users_answered
  GROUP BY creation_month
)
SELECT 
  tpm.creation_month,
  tpm.total_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(apm.asked_within_30 * 100.0, tpm.total_users), 2) as pct_asked_within_30,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(upm.answered_within_30 * 100.0, apm.asked_within_30), 2) as pct_answered_after_first_q
FROM total_per_month tpm
LEFT JOIN asked_per_month apm ON tpm.creation_month = apm.creation_month
LEFT JOIN answered_per_month upm ON tpm.creation_month = upm.creation_month
ORDER BY tpm.creation_month

WITH page_events AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS session_id,
    (SELECT value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    event_timestamp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX = '20210102'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
),
with_segs AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    page_location,
    event_timestamp,
    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segs,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS num_segments
  FROM page_events
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 5
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    page_location,
    event_timestamp,
    segs,
    num_segments,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(segs[OFFSET(3)]), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') AS seg4_is_category,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(segs[OFFSET(4)]), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') AS seg5_is_category,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(segs[OFFSET(num_segments - 1)], r'\+') AS last_has_plus,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(REPLACE(LOWER(segs[OFFSET(num_segments - 1)]), '+', ' '), r'(accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables)') AS last_is_category
  FROM with_segs
),
with_type AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    event_timestamp,
    CASE 
      WHEN last_has_plus AND (seg4_is_category OR seg5_is_category) AND NOT last_is_category THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN seg4_is_category OR seg5_is_category THEN 'PLP'
      ELSE 'OTHER'
    END AS page_type
  FROM classified
),
plp_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    plp.session_id,
    plp.event_timestamp AS plp_timestamp,
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 
      FROM with_type pdp
      WHERE pdp.session_id = plp.session_id
        AND pdp.page_type = 'PDP'
        AND pdp.event_timestamp > plp.event_timestamp
    ) AS has_subsequent_pdp
  FROM with_type plp
  WHERE plp.page_type = 'PLP'
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_subsequent_pdp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS plp_views_leading_to_pdp,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN has_subsequent_pdp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*)) * 100, 2) AS percentage_plp_to_pdp
FROM plp_analysis

WITH purchase_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
    ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20201130'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
    AND ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd IS NOT NULL
),
session_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    ga_session_id,
    SUM(purchase_revenue_in_usd) AS session_purchase_revenue
  FROM purchase_events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
),
user_session_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_purchase_sessions
  FROM session_revenue
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
  sr.user_pseudo_id,
  AVG(sr.session_purchase_revenue) AS avg_purchase_revenue_per_session
FROM session_revenue sr
JOIN user_session_counts usc ON sr.user_pseudo_id = usc.user_pseudo_id
GROUP BY sr.user_pseudo_id
ORDER BY sr.user_pseudo_id

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    (SELECT STRING_AGG(IF(e.key = 'page_location', e.value.string_value, NULL)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) e) as page_location_raw
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND event_name = 'page_view'
    AND (SELECT STRING_AGG(IF(e.key = 'page_location', e.value.string_value, NULL)) FROM UNNEST(event_params) e) LIKE '%shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%'
),
cleaned AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(page_location_raw, r'^https?://[^/]+', '') as raw_path
  FROM page_views
),
final AS (
  SELECT 
    REGEXP_REPLACE(raw_path, r'/+', '/') as cleaned_path,
    COUNT(*) as page_views
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY cleaned_path
  HAVING cleaned_path != ''
)
SELECT 
  cleaned_path
FROM final
ORDER BY page_views DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT 
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN has_exception = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100, 2) as crash_percentage
FROM (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_open_date,
    earliest_remove_date,
    has_exception
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      user_pseudo_id,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'first_open' THEN event_date END) as first_open_date,
      MIN(CASE WHEN event_name = 'app_remove' THEN event_date END) as earliest_remove_date,
      MAX(CASE WHEN event_name = 'app_exception' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_exception
    FROM (
      SELECT user_pseudo_id, event_date, event_timestamp, event_name
      FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
      WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
    )
    GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
    HAVING first_open_date LIKE '201809%'
  )
  WHERE earliest_remove_date IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(earliest_remove_date AS INT64) >= CAST(first_open_date AS INT64)
    AND CAST(earliest_remove_date AS INT64) - CAST(first_open_date AS INT64) <= 7
)
